This '''unidentified planet''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. It was the site of a [[Unidentified Separatist factory|Separatist factory]], which was [[Raid on a Separatist factory|raided]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in an attempt to steal an encrypted file held on a [[Datachip/Legends|data chip]], one crucial to the Separatists' war effort. Though the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] first managed to steal the data chip, it was soon recovered by a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid (Separatist factory)|B1 battle droid]] which fled the planet aboard a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]].<ref name="Update" />

The B1 battle droid then headed to a [[Unidentified Separatist asteroid base|Separatist asteroid base]] to return the data chip to a [[Unidentified Neimoidian councilor|Neimoidian councilor]] and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. The encrypted file on the data chip was then revealed to be containing the plans of a [[Updated battle droid|new model]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was designed in an intent to replace the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]]. However, in a surprising turn of events, the B1 battle droid fired on the data chip and destroyed it, when it realized that the new battle droid would render its companions obsolete, only to be used again as spare parts.<ref name="Update" />
